telegram.title: Telegram link
telegram.description: For notifications and login verification codes through the bot.
telegram.howTo: Open the bot, press /start and send your phone number. If it matches the number on your account, the chat is linked automatically.

twoFactor.title: Two-step sign-in
twoFactor.description: After your password, a 6-digit code is sent to Telegram. Even a stolen password is not enough to get in.
twoFactor.label: Verify through Telegram
twoFactor.on: On — a code is required at every sign-in
twoFactor.needsTelegram: Link Telegram first — otherwise the code has nowhere to arrive.
